topic: 近半年VLA在具身领域最大的技术突破

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): ‘最大技术突破’需要比较反应式 VLA、分层规划、世界模型后果预演、4D/几何动态、触觉纠错与闭环评测路线，并为每条路线检索反证。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-planning
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"vision language action" OR all:VLA) AND (all:"world model" OR all:"world action model") AND (all:planning OR all:foresight OR all:rollout)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 捕捉从直接动作预测转向动作条件后果预演的核心路线。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-structured-hierarchical-vla
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"robot policy") AND (all:structured OR all:hierarchical OR all:symbolic) AND (all:planning OR all:"world model")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索结构化里程碑、分层世界模型与长时程任务—运动规划。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-geometry-dynamics-vla
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"world action model") AND (all:4D OR all:geometry OR all:pointmap OR all:"point track") AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索用 4D/几何动态给 VLA 提供可执行物理表征的路线。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-correction-recovery
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"world action model") AND (all:recovery OR all:correction OR all:"self-correct" OR all:failure)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索失败检测、接触纠错、自我恢复和后训练。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-limits
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"world action model") AND (all:failure OR all:drift OR all:attack OR all:admissibility OR all:benchmark)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 主动检索世界模型路线的失效、攻击、可采信性与闭环评测反证。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-breakthrough-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org VLA world model structured planning robot manipulation 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: 官方 API 漏检时补充新方法名称。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-breakthrough-web
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs/2607 VLA robot world model planning
dynamic_suggestions.why: 校准 2026 年 7 月最新术语。

calibration_notes: arxiv-web calibration (high): StructVLA 使用 structured planner / structured frames / kinematic grounding 描述稀疏可执行预见。
arxiv-web calibration (high): H-WM 使用 hierarchical world model / logical and visual state transitions 描述分层长时程规划。
